exposure: LAC birthweight compared to previous cesarean birthweight
cohort: 505 women undergoing LAC with no prior vaginal delivery, delivering a singleton LGA newborn
finding: Maternal height and epidural anesthesia were independently associated with successful labor after cesarean in primiparous women carrying LGA newborns.
mod_finding: This study investigated factors associated with successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC), finding that epidural anesthesia was positively associated with successful VBAC.
